svg.text: -A2 SM 1221 DI 8 x 24 V DC, channels 0 to 3
Sensors -B1 to -B11: PNP, three-wire (brown +24V, blue 0V, black signal). Only the +24V and signal wires are drawn.
PLC terminal names (L+, M, 1M) must be checked against the Siemens S7-1200 System Manual. Spare channels are not drawn.
Theoretical design, not built, not certified
